title: March 2020: the hospital bill
intro: It's October 2019. You're Asha, in Class 12, and you help your family manage its money. Each month, after the household needs are paid, you decide how much to keep aside, save or invest. Prices are real; nobody in the story knows what comes next.
learningGoals: Notice how accessible savings can change the choices available when an urgent bill arrives.

reveal.lesson: On 23 March 2020 nobody knew whether prices would fall further or recover, just as nobody knows tomorrow today. Selling at that point turned a fall on paper into a real loss, and breaking the FD gave up interest two days before it matured. The family with an emergency fund didn't have to choose. Past prices don't predict future ones.
